**Recorded sense or problem**

A coherent ideal sheaf A on a locally Noetherian formal prescheme X defines the closed formal subprescheme carried by Supp(O_X/A) with structure sheaf (O_X/A)|Supp(O_X/A). Its canonical inclusion j=(psi,theta) is the morphism of topologically ringed spaces and formal preschemes induced by the inclusion of that support and the quotient homomorphism O_X to O_X/A. A closed immersion is a morphism that factors as an isomorphism onto such a closed formal subprescheme followed by its canonical inclusion. It is of finite type and is stable under the stated composition, base-change and product operations. None of these notions is merely a closed point-set inclusion, an arbitrary categorical monomorphism, a sheaf direct image or the scheme-theoretic closed image.
